title: Common types for AMC OS event contracts v1
description: Shared value types used by the event envelope and every event payload. Status: Draft (EA-007 §3). Money and quantities are decimal strings, never JSON numbers, so no consumer parses them as binary floating point (master prompt §3.2, ADR-0005).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with offset, for example 2026-11-20T18:35:02.123+05:30

business_date.description: Business date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the tenant's calendar

decimal_string.description: Exact decimal as a string. Scale is set by the producing engine's precision rules (FE specs), never by the transport

code.description: A code from the owning module's reference list or state model; values are defined there, not in the event contract

engine_version.description: Financial engine and version that produced the figures, for example FE-01@1.4.0
